I came in with very basic coding experience and got through about half of the semester before things started picking up; he has very helpful lectures and is often available outside of class.
He is very helpful when it comes to improving coding skills. I came in to the course with little coding experience, hating coding, but this class slowly get me somewhat more comfortable with coding.

Accent and his pace of speaking makes this class hard to understand. Be prepared to learn outside of class. Quiz makes you memorize all functions and cannot use any IDE or google to help. Overall hard class if you don't have a coding background.

reviews.comment: Cruzado is a cool teach. He also talks with super rad accent. I was good at programming before this class. Lowkey, my programming skill did not increase. This class was a walk in the park for someone with previous programming experience.

This class was insanely hard for me, certainly not impossible, but really hard. Professor Aitor did not do a great job communicating lessons, and did not explain things very well. Most times, he would give examples, and then find them to have errors, and instead of teaching us content, he would spend most of the time trying to fix the errors.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had here at TAMU. I highly recommend taking him for ENGR 102. Although the course can be difficult, it is super easy to pass if you just pay attention. He really cares about his students and will go over hw problems in office hours if you have questions.

The class is a 2-hour credit class with the work of a 4-hour credit class, it's also a firehose class, you have to learn a lot of new concepts and are expected to submit assignments on time and do them well in order to have a good grade. He has an accent that is a little difficult to understand at first but you pick up things.

Dr. Cruzado is literally one of the nicest professors I've ever had. Yeah ENGR 102 sucks, but he is really kind and actually wants his students to succeed. One time I stayed after class for 30 minutes and he helped me fix my code that wouldn't work.
Lots of lectures but you really only have to show up for the in class quizzes. Great professor though and you can typically finish all assignments during class

Makes me want to uninstall myself from existence. Too many labs, quizzes is over things not covered in class comes out of nowhere. I can not understand him in any way. AND HE EXPECTS ME TO WORK OVER THANKSGIVING BREAK FOR SOME REASON. His english is as good as my grammmmmar.

reviews.comment: Great professor, he genuinely cares about the class and student's learning. He has an accent but it isn't bad. The professor is very open to questions and encourages you to ask them if you don't understand something during the lectures or labs. Overall, I'd definitely recommend taking him for any class he offers, he's a 10/10.

By far one of the best professors the university has! He really does care about the students and the class learning. He welcomes any questions that the students have over the lecture and clears up any misconceptions. If you need more help, his office hours are great help and really works one-on-one with you to help you understand the material!
Prof Aitor is great. He does have a heavy accent, and ends every line with "yeah", but he is one of the best for engr 102. Def cares that you make an A IF YOU PUT IN EFFORT!
Not everything is on the syllabus. Don't make that mistake.

I would not recommend this professor. He assigns twice as many labs as other professor which are all very time consuming. His coding quizzes are hard and barely give you enough time to answer/process what it's asking you to code. It's very hard to understand him and he tends to run in circles during his lectures. If you can, avoid this professor.

Nicest and most caring professor that I have dealt with. Little things that I wasn't a fan of was his handwriting was really unorganized. Also, he has a little bit of an accent which sometimes makes it hard to understand him. Besides that, professor was always available after class and even gave SO MANY bonus points on the final score. Easy A+

Dr. Cruzado is a great professor! He's super kind and clear. Although his handwriting can be a bit messy, he genuinely wants his students to succeed. He gives enough homework for students to succeed, but not so much that it feels like busywork. He's definitely one of the better introductory ENGR professors!

Would definitely take him again. 216 was relatively easy if you know basic physics, but there's also quite a bit of statistics involved. I didn't know any stat going in and he really helped. definitely go to is office hours. he's really accessible there and will walk you through the homework.

He is the best professor I have ever had. I had him for both ENGR 102 and PHYS 216 and I'm so glad I took him again. His handwriting isn't the best through zoom but he is super nice if you ask what he wrote. He encourages students to ask questions and holds office hours where he goes over every homework problem. Also gave lots of extra credit!

Take him if you can!! Although Zoom lectures could be a drag, he is INCREDIBLY genuine and clearly cares about his students. Responds quickly and nicely to all emails and questions!! He holds extensive office hours and was generous towards the end with extra credit. His handwriting does take getting used to!!
IF YOU CAN, TAKE HIS CLASS!! He was an amazing professor and really cared about his students and our learning. Best professor!!

One of the best professors I have ever had. He is very understanding of the difficulty of the class and doesn't mind helping out students when it comes to grades. He has helpful office hours where he will cover everything he assigns. He is also very generous if you finish the work that he assigns. Get professor Aitor for 216 if you can!

I took Aitorand loved him. At the end of the semester he gave an enormous amount of extra credit, to the point where I only needed a 28 on the final to get an A. He cares a lot and if you email him about something, he's very accommodating, it's great. The workload of this class comes from the labs, which isn't him, it's TAs, but not hard.

Pretty good Prof. My fav part about the class was that he would go over each hw in office hours and post the lecture recordings, they were extremely helpful! Labs take up the most time in this class. Professor's lectures were very understandable. Also, he gave a LOT of extra credit. Overall, a solid choice for this course.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Replies very fast to emails. He also cares a lot about students and will allow extensions if needed. Would 100% recommend everyone to take him.

I am horrible at coding and got a C in 102 but Prof. Garcia made the class super easy and did almost every homework question with us in office hours. I only had to get a 50 on the final to get an A in the class and put almost no time into the class.

Amazing Prof!!! 100% recommend to anyone. Professor Cruzado is so caring and he wants all of his students to succeed. He holds many office hours to help with home works and responds quickly to emails. If you do the work and attend class it should be an easy A.
Great teacher! He made some unclear concepts very understandable!

I've had Dr. Cruzado for two semesters now and he has been amazing for both semesters. He is really passionate about teaching which is rare for many professors. He truly understands the material and he is really easy to get access to after class. He posts his lectures and notes which are really helpful. True Gem

Great professor. He genuinely wants his students to succeed and is always accessible outside of class. He gives lots of extra credit and explains homework problems and in class problems very well either during lecture or in office hours. Would definitely recommend taking him if you can!
Great professor and really cares for his students. Took him online during the spring 2021 semester and he was very helpful. Gives opportunities for partial credit as well.

The accent makes it a little hard to understand him, and you have to learn to decipher his handwriting, but he very clearly wants his students to do well. The material for this class is hard and doesn't really feel connected to phys 206 or engr 102 from last semester, but he does a good job of teaching it. Let us bring a formula sheet to the final.
Dr. Cruzado was a good proffesor. His lectures were written poorly (hard to read) at times, but he welcomes questions and cares about your success.

I took aitor for engr 102 and 216. He is the most caring prof ever! Honestly compared to my other friends profs, I scored with aitor. He has office hours where you can ask any questions about the hw. His handwriting is hard to understand due to an online platform but I imagine once it is in person his handwriting will be easier to understand.

reviews.comment: I genuinely cannot recommend him enough. So nice, so accommodating, so understanding. Before lectures he would ask us about our input on things and it felt like he genuinely cared about us doing well. His lectures are very clear, and although homework can be hard he is really helpful during office hours. Take him if you get the chance!!
Caring professor and does a phenomenal job in teaching the course materials.

I gave him a 3 because he is super nice, cares about his students, and is very accommodating. That being said he has a thick accent and I've seen chickens with better handwriting. If you take this professor know that his lectures are likely going to do nothing for you. Also this was COVID year, so his writing might be better on non-online mediums.

Aitor Garcia was an outstanding professor. It seemed like he really did care if his students were understanding the material. He would go over any homework questions that one had. Also, he was easy to reach out to and gave a quick response.

BEST ENGINEERING PROF AT TAMU. Seriously if you have the option to take him, do it. Super caring about his students, responds to emails within 5 minutes tops (even on weekends). Office hours are super helpful and walks through the problems with his students. I took him for Engineering 216 and has been a great experience.

This man is so sweet, a little difficult to understand over zoom but I would have absolutely loved him in person. He cares about his students and makes sure we understand the material, the only reason I'm getting a bad grade is because I didn't complete the labs haha, but he's really great and I absolutely recommend him!!

Professor Garcia has hands down the best office hours at TAMU. Without them, homework would be a real pain. He made the instruction part of 216 easy, explaining every topic in detail and even helping with code. Thank you professor

He was a great teacher. The lectures were informative and he made sure that we understood the content. The homeworks were simple, but made sure that we understood what was required. He was very helpful for any questions you might have, he is very accessible in his office hours. He also posted recordings of them in case you couldn't go.

I have had Professor Aitor Cruzado Garcia for two semesters now, and he is by far one of my best professors I will probably have all throughout college. His main thing is that he cares that the students know the information more then anything. As long as you pay attention to lectures and learn the material, you should pass no problem.

Professor Garcia was a really good professor. He made many confusing concepts in this class easy to understand. You do have to show up every time, but he makes it easy to learn. Be ready for many lab reports and a lot of homework assignments that you may not understand, but tune in to his office hours where he guides you through most problems!

Dr. Cruzado really cares about his students. Going to his office hours really helped in boosting my grades. He really cares about his students and tries to alleviate any stress by having flexible deadlines. I would really recommend this professor if you want to be successful in ENGR216.
He is such an amazing prof. Records all of his lectures and office hour videos and also shows how to answer the homework problems.

I took ENGR216 with Aitor during COVID when all classes were online. While some professors made it impossible to learn, Aitor was one of the profs that cared about students and gave lots of help. While this class does have a good amount of homework, he holds lots of office hours to help students. If needing to take this class, take it with Aitor.

He is a great prof!!! He has a thick accent that is hard to understand at first, but you get used to it after the first few classes. He really cares about getting students a good grade and offers a lot of opportunities to get points back. Almost every homework that we do has extra credit questions. Definitely recommend him!!!

Awesome guy. He has an accent and sometimes he write his alphabets funny. But this is just a heads up and not a complaint. There shouldn't be a reason for anyone not to have a 100 for every HW, since he post office hour videos of him doing them. He doesn't make or grade the labs (50% of your grade), that's Phys 206. 5 Stars, take him.

Truly so nice and helpful!! Make sure to go to his office hours or watch the recordings because he goes through the homework. Although at times it seems like a lot of assignments, he gives a couple of weeks for you to work on it.
Nice Prof, Difficult to understand at first but once you get over that he teaches well.

reviews.comment: He's a very caring professor, and wants to see us understand the material. He gives so much help with the homework and assignments, and is always very happy and upbeat in class. One of my favorite professors I've had

Professor Garcia is really helpful with the homeworks and he makes the class manageable. Coming from some who struggles a bit in other classes, this class was no problem. I would definitely take this class again and the homeworks are not as hard as I have seen from other ENGR216 professors.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Somewhat hard to pay attention due to habit of saying 'yes' frequently. Overall assignments were very clear and was very communicative. Gave a ton of extra credit.

Aitor is an amazing professor. I don't particularly enjoy mechanics but he made the class more enjoyable. PARTICIPATE! He is so helpful, but you have to make sure you pay attention and participate! Go to office hours and you will do well. Take Aitor as your engr 216 prof you won't regret it.

One of the best professors I've had the pleasure of taking during my time in general engineering. I had taken him in ENGR 102 and he was so helpful, caring, and flexible with his students that when he announced he was going to teach ENGR/PHYS 216 the next semester I jumped at the chance to take him again. A true hidden gem. Definitely recommend him
Overall a very helpful professor who knows what he is talking about and very understanding.

This class is divided into two, Prof Cruzado is in charge of lecture and he did such a good job! This was his first semester teaching the class & he uses the lecture to help us know what's expected from us in hw. 2nd time taking the class & definitely enjoyed this 1 better. GO TO OFFICE HRS! DO HW!! LAB sucks:( unclear & confusing but prof helped.

I met Dr. Cruzado as a freshman in ENGR 102. It was my first computer science class, and it was a huge reason for my decision to major in CS. Throughout the course, Dr. Cruzado readily made himself available to meet and discuss difficult questions, and would not be satisfied until he saw that the concepts were truly internalized. 100% recommend!!!

This is a covid Fall 2020 review. I had no coding experience. He cares that his students succeed so go to office hours. We had no group work only individual assignments that we did with the prof/TA together. Honestly, it was a lot of work but it helped me actually learn for the tests. He doesnt grade hard but make sure you check all the 'boxes'.

He is the few professor whom I've met and really liked. He is very caring. If you do not understand the material, go visit him during his office hour or set up an appointment and he is more than willing to help you to improve your understanding and grade. He will be your best professor for Aero 220 or 485 -Intro to Aero computation. I loved it!

Dr. Cruzado is a great professor, he is willing to stay with you outside of class so you can understand the material. He was willing to work with me even outside his office hours so I can understand the concepts better. I would take him if you can, you won't regret it!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is a very kind and caring professor who will go out of his way to make sure you understand his course. You will only get out of this course as much as you put into it so do not slack and blow off any of the assignments. Other than the crazy amount of labs and the time it takes to do those labs, his course is very manageable.

Dr. Cruzado was my one of my best professors this semester. Despite the fact that COVID-19 caused this new concept of programming to be even harder to grasp, he always responds to emails and finds places to give you extra credit. Do not get discouraged when you are struggling with the assignments. He loves to help and truly cares for his students!

Professor Cruzado was a very good teacher. The material can be quite difficult if you've never dealt with python before but if you go to him for help he can be very helpful. Make sure to go to recitation because the TA's can help you with the lab assignments.

Professor Cruzado is definitely my favorite professor as a freshman. My classes this year were pretty unexpectedly hard, including this one, but we received LOTS of help from TAs and the professor himself. He is great and teaches the material very well. He pauses a lot and makes sure students aren't lost during his lectures.

Aitor Cruzado Garcia is my best professor this semester. I signed up for ENGR102 with prior coding experience, and was told it would be an easy A. The class is actually very difficult, even with prior experience. Without Aitor's support, the class would have been 10x harder. I was able to help friends in other sections because he taught me so well.

Had him for an 8am, and he still managed to be very enthusiastic and energetic during the class. He is very helpful during his office hours so even though there is a lot of homework, it is not that hard considering he goes over the assignments with you if you have questions. Overall very cool guy, who cares about his students.

Great professor overall. Extremely helpful both in and outside of class although he can be a bit forgetful/late on things sometimes. Adapted well to a online learning environment. He isn't as involved with the labs and you do have to do a bit of reading, but there is a lot of opportunity for extra credit.

Cruzado is a really great professor. Even though the class was online because of Corna, he made it fun to attend. He was always accessible out of class through email. Most of the time his office hours would go over time which he does not seem to mind if students are actively engaged.

Professor Cruzado is excellent, and what he sometimes lacks in understandability, he makes up for in spades with his helpfulness in office hours and numerous opportunities for bonus points. You will have to read through the interactive textbook, but it's not hard to do. He will answer any and all questions with respect, and is overall a great guy.

reviews.comment: He really cares about his students understanding the material. He did use all of the lab time as lecture time, but he goes through the lab assignments and takes questions. When he teaches on the powerpoints he scribbles with his mouse and it is unreadable. His office hours are very useful and he always posts them on his ecampus.

Professor Cruzado is amazing. He knows exactly what he is talking about and he is really helpful. I have enjoyed going to his class because he makes programming easier to understand. His office hours are incredible.

Professor Aitor is one of the best professors I have had. The class its self is pretty difficult especially if you have no prior coding experience, but he is very patient in helping all his students learn and goes over many of the labs and walks you through them, while still making you think and do them. Overall great professor and super caring!

Prof Cruzado was amazing. His accent is thick but one will get used to it quite quickly if he/she is paying attention. The prof really cares if each and everyone in the class has comprehended the materials in class and it really shows.

If you go to his office hours for your programs he will sit there for as long as it takes to help you understand. You can tell he is extremely passionate about programming and wants everyone to learn. Sometimes his lectures can be very long but overall he is a very good professor.

Prof Aitor was a solid intro to coding professor. I had never looked into it before and now i can take on large projects with ease. Watch out for his accent, sometimes its hard to understand him. Loved him as a teacher

Prof. Cruzado has a pretty obvious accent but he makes sure that if you can't understand him because of it to clarify everything. He helps you through lab assignments and homework during office hours and class. The work was overall pretty easy but he made it even easier. #1 Prof. at A&M for ENGR 102.

Professor Garcia is a solid choice for ENGR102. He explains the material well and checks on whether everyone is understanding it. He also does some of the lab assignments with you in class so you have a better understanding of the coding process. I would highly recommend taking him.

The best professor or teacher I've had from high school to now college. He cares about his students, and making sure they truly understand the material. I've never had a professor as dedicated as him, I will definitely miss having him. His office hours are super helpful and his lectures are easy to follow. I recommend him a million percent.

He is very caring about you understanding the material. If you ask him questions he will be very specific and helpful. The best way to understand is to attend his office hours, he works with you one on one to help you. The quizzes and tests aren't hard if you ask questions and understand the labs.

Cruzado was really good and 102 wasnt too hard by itself, the only complaint I have about him is that he often overestimated our previous knowledge(hes normally a 400 lvl professor) so sometimes the quizzes were a little tough but he really does care about everyone getting a good grade. Super nice guy, definitely would take him again.

He has an accent, but overall he is a great professor. Dr. Cruzado does have an accent, but he cares about you and wants you to learn if you're willing to put in the effort. He is very nice and helpful in office hours and gives you plenty of material to prepare for exams. He's definitely better than other 102 professors out there. Take him if you can!
